name: Lurker Venom
summary: Around Loch Modan, dwarven defenders need Lurker Venom to counter Dark Iron sabotage. The toxin comes from predatory spiders in the rocky hills and woods.

sections.title: A Volatile Reagent
sections.body: Lurker Venom helps dwarves disarm Dark Iron explosives. Ashlan Stonesmirk, an explosives expert, named the spiders’ poison as an ingredient for the mixture Chief Engineer Hinderweir prepares. The solvent combines the venom with rare minerals and tears from the loch’s crocolisks, forming a reactive compound that can disarm complex explosives. Lurker spiders range from common wood lurkers to the matriarch Shanda the Spinner, and their bites threaten travelers and mountaineers across the hills and crags.

faq.q: Where does Lurker Venom come from?
faq.answer: Loch Modan’s lurker spiders provide the venom, including Cliff Lurkers, Forest Lurkers, Wood Lurkers, and their matriarch Shanda the Spinner.

faq.q: What is Lurker Venom used for?
aliases: why do i need lurker venom
what does hinderweir do with venom
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir uses the venom in a chemical mixture to neutralize and defuse explosives placed by Dark Iron infiltrators around the Stonewrought Dam.

faq.q: Why use venom to defuse an explosive?
aliases: how does venom stop dark iron bombs
faq.answer: Dwarven engineers use reactive, acidic, or caustic mixtures to dissolve delicate mechanical parts or neutralize unstable blasting powders without setting them off.

faq.q: Is Shanda the Spinner the only source?
aliases: do i have to kill shanda
faq.answer: No. Shanda carries the venom, but common wild lurker spiders in Loch Modan’s woodlands and rocky cliffs can provide it too.

angles.text: Using organic toxins to disable hostile explosives shows how dwarven engineers improvise with reactive materials in battle.
As a dwarf, you know Loch Modan’s mountaineers and defenders use dangers from the local wilds to protect vital Khaz Modan works from the Dark Iron clan.
